query:
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payments.free_win WHERE business_id = $1)
             OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payments.entity_key k WHERE k.business_id = $1 AND (
                  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payments.free_win_claim c
                           WHERE c.kind = k.kind AND c.digest = k.digest)
               OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payments.entity_key o
                            JOIN payments.free_win w ON w.business_id = o.business_id
                           WHERE o.kind = k.kind AND o.digest = k.digest
                             AND o.business_id <> $1)))
